case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for your openness about wage costs. We value the craftsmanship of your foundry workforce and the reliable cooperation between our companies, and we take the pressure from rising metal-sector wages seriously.

At the same time, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have prepared options that reflect your situation:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

All options offer a longer contract term for added planning security. Option C keeps your current payment terms unchanged. We would be glad to hear which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for acknowledging the pressure from rising wages and for proposing a 24-month contract. We value our long-standing cooperation and are pleased to accept the longer term for mutual planning security. However, your proposed prices are not feasible; we can offer €51.30 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days payment.

Our complete Angebot consists of a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving closer to our position. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

As a family-run foundry, we must ensure that the rising wage costs are covered to maintain our quality and reliability. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.60 for the 24-month contract with 30 days payment. 

Specifically, our Angebot stands at a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our shared history and look forward to continuing our work together with the same dependability you have come to expect from us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
